The climate in Budva

Budva is about 8 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 31°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 5°C. Around 2270 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in November (about 373 mm).

Best time to visit Budva

The most pleasant weather in Budva is usually in May, June, September and October: average highs are between 21°C and 27°C, with up to 15 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
